name: Dice tray
description: Rolls dice for chat and keeps the session's best roll: an example of a Lua plugin.

actions.name: roll
actions.label: Roll dice
actions.description: Rolls dice and gives back the total, each die, and a line to say.

params.name: who
params.label: Who's rolling
params.hint: Empty: the viewer who typed the command

actions.name: roll_and_say
actions.label: Roll dice and say it in chat
actions.description: Rolls dice and says the result in chat itself, with a cheer for the best roll of the session.

params.name: who
params.label: Who's rolling
params.hint: Empty: the viewer who typed the command

actions.name: open_round
actions.label: Open a dice round
actions.description: Opens a round for a while: rolls in it count, then it says who rolled highest and sends A dice round ends.

actions.name: gamble
actions.label: Gamble points
actions.description: The viewer stakes points on a roll from 1 to 100: at the winning roll or more they get twice the stake back. Says it in chat.

actions.name: best
actions.label: The session's best roll
actions.description: Who has the best roll since the plugin was turned on, and how many rolls there have been.

events.name: round_ended
events.label: A dice round ends
events.description: A round opened with Open a dice round closed: who rolled highest, with what, and how many rolled.

values.name: winner
values.label: The winner's name (empty with no rolls)

events.name: new_best
events.label: A new best roll
events.description: Someone beat the session's best roll.

settings.label: Cheer a new best roll in chat
Gamble: the roll that wins
settings.hint: A roll from 1 to 100 at this or more pays back twice the stake
